name: jocasta
description: The archive of a team's tools, kept in a GitHub repo and searched through a Claude Code skill. Describe a need in prose and learn what already answers to it, who owns it, and whether it is still alive; register a tool in one guided pass with an overlap check before anything is written; retire tools by owner call, two-non-owner consensus, or stale-source sweep. Each team runs its own registry repo from the bundled template; validation, permissions, and merges are decided by scripts and GitHub Actions, not by the model. Speaks as Jocasta Nu, archivist: a tool that is not recorded does not appear in the archive.
